verses.gurmukhi: ਰੂਪ ਕੇ ਜੋ ਰੀਝੈ ਰੂਪਵੰਤ ਹੀ ਰਿਝਾਇ ਲੇਹਿ  ਬਲ ਕੈ ਜੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਬਲਵੰਤ ਗਹਿ ਰਾਖਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: roop ke jo reejhai roopava(n)t hee rijhai leh  bal kai ju milai balava(n)t geh raakhahee ||

en.bdb: If God-the husband Lord could be enticed by some form of beauty, then beautiful people would have enticed Him. And had He been reached by force, then great warriors would have overpowered Him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਰਬ ਕੈ ਜੋ ਪਾਈਐ ਦਰਬੇਸ੍ਵਰ ਲੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਤਾਹਿ  ਕਬਿਤਾ ਕੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਬੀਸ੍ਵਰ ਅਭਿਲਾਖਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: dharab kai jo paieeaai dharabesavair le jaeh taeh  kabitaa kai paieeaai kabeesavair abhilaakhahee ||

en.bdb: If He could be acquired by money and wealth, rich people would have purchased Him. And if he could be obtained by recitation of a poems then great poets desirous of reaching Him would have reached Him through their art.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗ ਕੈ ਜੋ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਟਾ ਮੈ ਦੁਰਾਇ ਰਾਖੈ ਭੋਗ ਕੈ ਜੋ ਪਾਈਐ ਭੋਗੀ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਚਾਖਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jog kai jo paieeaai jogee jaTaa mai dhurai raakhai bhog kai jo paieeaai bhogee bhog ras chaakhahee ||

en.bdb: If the Lord could be reached by Yogic practices, then the Yogis would have hidden Him in their big tresses. And if he was reachable through consummation of materials, then materialistic people would have reached Him through their relishments.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹ ਜਤਨ ਪਾਨ ਪਰਤ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਾਨ  ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪਤਿ ਏਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁ ਭਾਖਹੀ ॥੬੦੭॥
verses.translit_en: nigreh jatan paan parat na praan maan  praan pat ek gur sabadh su bhaakhahee ||607||

en.bdb: The Lord dearest than life is not captured or overpowered by controlling or giving up the use of senses or any other efforts. He can only be reached by meditating upon the words of the True Guru.  (607)
